title: FruitStand
body:
The fruit seller greets Hana with an HUGE smile.
[[1  KNOCK OVER THE STAND!!|PushStand]]
[[2  Steal a fruit? |TakeFruit]]
[[3  Leave the stand alone|LeaveStand]]

title: PushStand
body:
<<knock_over>>
HANA KNOCKS OVER THE STAND! Fruit scatters across the pavement. 
The seller calmly cleans it up.
SELLER: Oops! Let me clean up this mess! Enjoy your day!

title: TakeFruit
body:
<<take_fruit>>
Hana pockets a piece of fruit without paying. 
SELLER: Please, take it! I'm happy to share.
